declarations.name: Trees.level
declarations.header: def level : BinaryTree α → Nat → List α

declarations.name: Trees.level_nil
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem level_nil (k : Nat) : level (.nil : BinaryTree α) k = []

declarations.name: Trees.level_node_zero
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem level_node_zero (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    level (.node a l r) 0 = [a]

declarations.name: Trees.level_node_succ
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem level_node_succ (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) (k : Nat) :
    level (.node a l r) (k + 1) = level l k ++ level r k

declarations.name: Trees.mergeLevels
declarations.header: def mergeLevels : List (List α) → List (List α) → List (List α)

declarations.name: Trees.levels
declarations.header: def levels : BinaryTree α → List (List α)

declarations.name: Trees.levels_nil
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem levels_nil : levels (.nil : BinaryTree α) = []

declarations.name: Trees.levels_node
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem levels_node (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    levels (.node a l r) = [a] :: mergeLevels (levels l) (levels r)

declarations.name: Trees.mergeLevels_length
declarations.header:
theorem mergeLevels_length (xs ys : List (List α)) :
    (mergeLevels xs ys).length = max xs.length ys.length

declarations.name: Trees.mergeLevels_getD
declarations.header:
theorem mergeLevels_getD (xs ys : List (List α)) (k : Nat) :
    (mergeLevels xs ys).getD k [] = xs.getD k [] ++ ys.getD k []

declarations.name: Trees.levels_length
declarations.header: theorem levels_length (t : BinaryTree α) : (levels t).length = t.height

declarations.name: Trees.levels_getD
declarations.header:
theorem levels_getD (t : BinaryTree α) (k : Nat) :
    (levels t).getD k [] = level t k

declarations.name: Trees.levels_getElem?
declarations.header:
theorem levels_getElem? (t : BinaryTree α) (k : Nat) (hk : k < t.height) :
    (levels t)[k]? = some (level t k)

declarations.name: Trees.Rose.node
declarations.header: | node (label : α) (children : List (Rose α))

declarations.name: Trees.Rose.mirror
declarations.header: def mirror (t : Rose α) : Rose α

declarations.name: Trees.Rose.mirror_node
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem mirror_node (a : α) (children : List (Rose α)) :
    mirror (.node a children) = .node a ((children.map mirror).reverse)

declarations.name: Trees.Rose.mirror_mirror
declarations.header: theorem mirror_mirror (t : Rose α) : mirror (mirror t) = t

declarations.name: Trees.insertFirst
declarations.header: def insertFirst (x : α) : BinaryTree α → List (BinaryTree α)

declarations.name: Trees.insertFirst_nil
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem insertFirst_nil (x : α) :
    insertFirst x .nil = [.node x .nil .nil]

declarations.name: Trees.insertFirst_node
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem insertFirst_node (x a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    insertFirst x (.node a l r) = .node x .nil (.node a l r) ::
      (insertFirst x l).map (fun l' => .node a l' r)

declarations.name: Trees.removeFirst
declarations.header: def removeFirst : BinaryTree α → BinaryTree α

declarations.name: Trees.removeFirst_node_of_ne_nil
declarations.header:
theorem removeFirst_node_of_ne_nil (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) (hl : l ≠ .nil) :
    removeFirst (.node a l r) = .node a (removeFirst l) r

declarations.name: Trees.nil_not_mem_insertFirst
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem nil_not_mem_insertFirst (x : α) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    (.nil : BinaryTree α) ∉ insertFirst x t

declarations.name: Trees.inorder_of_mem_insertFirst
declarations.header:
theorem inorder_of_mem_insertFirst (x : α) {s t : BinaryTree α}
    (ht : t ∈ insertFirst x s) : inorder t = x :: inorder s

declarations.name: Trees.removeFirst_of_mem_insertFirst
declarations.header:
theorem removeFirst_of_mem_insertFirst (x : α) {s t : BinaryTree α}
    (ht : t ∈ insertFirst x s) : removeFirst t = s

declarations.name: Trees.nodup_insertFirst
declarations.header:
theorem nodup_insertFirst (x : α) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    (insertFirst x t).Nodup

declarations.name: Trees.exists_insertFirst_of_inorder_cons
declarations.header:
theorem exists_insertFirst_of_inorder_cons (x : α) (xs : List α) (t : BinaryTree α)
    (ht : inorder t = x :: xs) :
    ∃ s, inorder s = xs ∧ t ∈ insertFirst x s

declarations.name: Trees.insertFirst_flatMap_nodup
declarations.header:
theorem insertFirst_flatMap_nodup (x : α) (ts : List (BinaryTree α))
    (hts : ts.Nodup) : (ts.flatMap (insertFirst x)).Nodup

declarations.name: Trees.enumTree
declarations.header: def enumTree : List α → List (BinaryTree α)

declarations.name: Trees.enumTree_nil
declarations.header: @[simp] theorem enumTree_nil : enumTree ([] : List α) = [.nil]

declarations.name: Trees.enumTree_cons
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem enumTree_cons (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    enumTree (x :: xs) = (enumTree xs).flatMap (insertFirst x)

declarations.name: Trees.mem_enumTree_iff
declarations.header:
theorem mem_enumTree_iff (xs : List α) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    t ∈ enumTree xs ↔ inorder t = xs

declarations.name: Trees.set_enumTree
declarations.header:
theorem set_enumTree (xs : List α) :
    {t | t ∈ enumTree xs} = {t : BinaryTree α | inorder t = xs}

declarations.name: Trees.enumTree_nodup
declarations.header: theorem enumTree_nodup (xs : List α) : (enumTree xs).Nodup

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.empty_label_enum
declarations.header: theorem empty_label_enum : enumTree ([] : List Empty) = [.nil]

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.empty_label_nodup
declarations.header: theorem empty_label_nodup : (enumTree ([] : List Empty)).Nodup

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.singleton_enum
declarations.header: theorem singleton_enum (a : α) : enumTree [a] = [.node a .nil .nil]

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.pair_enum
declarations.header:
theorem pair_enum (a b : α) :
    enumTree [a, b] =
      [.node a .nil (.node b .nil .nil), .node b (.node a .nil .nil) .nil]

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.repeated_shapes_nodup
declarations.header:
theorem repeated_shapes_nodup (a : α) :
    ([.node a .nil (.node a .nil .nil), .node a (.node a .nil .nil) .nil] :
      List (BinaryTree α)).Nodup

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.repeated_shapes_distinct
declarations.header:
theorem repeated_shapes_distinct (a : α) :
    (.node a .nil (.node a .nil .nil) : BinaryTree α) ≠
      .node a (.node a .nil .nil) .nil

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.three_enum
declarations.header:
theorem three_enum :
    enumTree ([1, 2, 3] : List Nat) =
      [.node 1 .nil (.node 2 .nil (.node 3 .nil .nil)),
        .node 2 (.node 1 .nil .nil) (.node 3 .nil .nil),
        .node 1 .nil (.node 3 (.node 2 .nil .nil) .nil),
        .node 3 (.node 1 .nil (.node 2 .nil .nil)) .nil,
        .node 3 (.node 2 (.node 1 .nil .nil) .nil) .nil]

declarations.name: TreeEnumerationExamples.three_nodup
declarations.header: theorem three_nodup : (enumTree ([1, 2, 3] : List Nat)).Nodup

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct?
declarations.header: def reconstruct? [DecidableEq α] : List α → List α → Option (BinaryTree α)

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct?_nil_nil
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem reconstruct?_nil_nil [DecidableEq α] :
    reconstruct? ([] : List α) [] = some .nil

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct?_nil_cons
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem reconstruct?_nil_cons [DecidableEq α] (a : α) (ino : List α) :
    reconstruct? [] (a :: ino) = none

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct?_cons
declarations.header:
theorem reconstruct?_cons [DecidableEq α] (a : α) (pre ino : List α) :
    reconstruct? (a :: pre) ino =
      if a ∈ ino then
        match reconstruct? (pre.take (ino.idxOf a)) (ino.take (ino.idxOf a)),
          reconstruct? (pre.drop (ino.idxOf a)) (ino.drop (ino.idxOf a + 1)) with
        | some l, some r => some (.node a l r)
        | _, _ => none
      else none

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct?_cons_of_not_mem
declarations.header:
theorem reconstruct?_cons_of_not_mem [DecidableEq α] (a : α) (pre ino : List α)
    (ha : a ∉ ino) : reconstruct? (a :: pre) ino = none

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct
declarations.header: def reconstruct [DecidableEq α] (pre ino : List α) : BinaryTree α

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct_nil_nil
declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem reconstruct_nil_nil [DecidableEq α] :
    reconstruct ([] : List α) [] = .nil

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct_of_none
declarations.header:
theorem reconstruct_of_none [DecidableEq α] {pre ino : List α}
    (h : reconstruct? pre ino = none) : reconstruct pre ino = .nil

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct?_traversals
declarations.header:
theorem reconstruct?_traversals [DecidableEq α] (t : BinaryTree α)
    (hn : (preorder t).Nodup) : reconstruct? (preorder t) (inorder t) = some t

declarations.name: Trees.reconstruct_traversals
declarations.header:
theorem reconstruct_traversals [DecidableEq α] (t : BinaryTree α)
    (hn : (preorder t).Nodup) : reconstruct (preorder t) (inorder t) = t

theorem sample_reconstruct :

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.singleton_reconstruct
declarations.header:
theorem singleton_reconstruct [DecidableEq α] (a : α) :
    reconstruct [a] [a] = .node a .nil .nil

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.empty_labels
declarations.header: theorem empty_labels : reconstruct ([] : List Empty) [] = .nil

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.empty_mismatch
declarations.header: theorem empty_mismatch : reconstruct? ([] : List Nat) [1] = none

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.empty_mismatch_fallback
declarations.header: theorem empty_mismatch_fallback : reconstruct ([] : List Nat) [1] = .nil

declarations.header: theorem missing_root : reconstruct? ([9] : List Nat) [3] = none

declarations.header: theorem surplus_preorder : reconstruct? ([1, 2] : List Nat) [1] = none

declarations.header: theorem surplus_inorder : reconstruct? ([1] : List Nat) [1, 2] = none

declarations.header:

    ([1, 2, 3] : List Nat).Perm [3, 1, 2] ∧
      reconstruct? ([1, 2, 3] : List Nat) [3, 1, 2] = none

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.same_labels_not_joint_traversals
declarations.header:
theorem same_labels_not_joint_traversals :
    ¬ ∃ t : BinaryTree Nat, preorder t = [1, 2, 3] ∧ inorder t = [3, 1, 2]

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.leftRepeated
declarations.header: def leftRepeated (a : α) : BinaryTree α

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.rightRepeated
declarations.header: def rightRepeated (a : α) : BinaryTree α

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.repeated_traversals
declarations.header:
theorem repeated_traversals (a : α) :
    preorder (leftRepeated a) = [a, a] ∧ preorder (rightRepeated a) = [a, a] ∧
      inorder (leftRepeated a) = [a, a] ∧ inorder (rightRepeated a) = [a, a]

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.repeated_trees_distinct
declarations.header: theorem repeated_trees_distinct (a : α) : leftRepeated a ≠ rightRepeated a

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.repeated_preorder_not_nodup
declarations.header: theorem repeated_preorder_not_nodup (a : α) : ¬ (preorder (leftRepeated a)).Nodup

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.repeated_parser_choice
declarations.header:
theorem repeated_parser_choice [DecidableEq α] (a : α) :
    reconstruct [a, a] [a, a] = rightRepeated a

declarations.name: TreeReconstructionExamples.repeated_left_not_recovered
declarations.header:
theorem repeated_left_not_recovered [DecidableEq α] (a : α) :
    reconstruct (preorder (leftRepeated a)) (inorder (leftRepeated a)) ≠ leftRepeated a
